feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 November 2026 4:50pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 22 November 2026 at 4:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure and associated slow-moving frontal zone to the west and south of the British Isles as an area of high pressure in the Norwegian Sea extends a ridge over the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Southeast 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight. Increasing 5 or 6 in western waters tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but slight in the east, becoming slight or moderate early tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 Monday evening, then increasing 7 or gale 8 Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate quickly building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain arriving from the west overnight into Tuesday, heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain later.
